::: {.obsidian-dpia}
:::

State the processing overview in one paragraph. Name the data, the
purposes, the systems, and the data subjects.

# Lawful basis

State the lawful basis for the processing under Article 6. Name any
special category basis under Article 9.

# Necessity and proportionality

State why the processing is necessary. Show that the purposes cannot
be met with less intrusive means.

# Risk assessment

Identify the risks to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects.
Rate each risk for likelihood and severity. Use a table.

# Mitigation measures

Map each risk to the measure that mitigates it. State the residual
risk after the measure.

# DPO consultation

Record the data protection officer consultation. State the opinion
and any conditions imposed.
